entries.cd3b731493f99e1e: It has brass rod and other production equipment at its head factory in Sakai City, and holds logistics warehouses and other facilities at the Osaka Brass Company in Higashinari Ward, Osaka City. Under a framework with the wrought copper companies of the CK-Sanetsu Group, it engages in mutual OEM supply of products and joint purchasing of raw materials, and the structure allows the group to complement each other in the range of product types and raw material procurement that would be difficult to hold alone.

entries.daa8316103e09e75: Ichihara Kinzoku Sangyo Co., Ltd. is the largest customer, accounting for 13.2% of revenue. Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. and Hamai Co., Ltd. are also product sales customers for wrought copper products.
entries.e531f50c63158cf3: A manufacturer of copper and copper alloy products headquartered in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, it is a consolidated subsidiary of CK Sanetsu Co., Ltd. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its business is a single segment, the copper and copper alloy products business. It produces brass rods and other products at its headquarters factory in Sakai, and places its logistics warehouse and other facilities at Osaka Kodo Company in Higashinari Ward, Osaka City. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 92.
entries.eb0967c1e0d55059: Manufacture and sale of products processed from copper and copper alloy products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,640 million, up 31.4% year on year.
